metadata.title: Pyrotechnic Abstract Texture with Layered Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy design featuring a vertically motion-blurred fire background with heavy, outlined slab-serif typography layered in the center.
excludeWhen: realistic photography without motion blur is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, vertically-streaked abstract background of amber, gold, and black, resembling fire seen through a motion-blur filter, serving as a backdrop for multi-layered, high-contrast serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Text is centered horizontally and vertically
Smaller sans-serif text sits directly above larger serif text
Background motion blur creates a sense of upward heat and energy
Outer glow on text separates it from the busy background
coreInvariants: Vertical motion blur effect on the background texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is the primary subject, centered and occupying the middle horizontal third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, outlined serif text in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical streaks of the background upward, then settles on the horizontal text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with texture and large-scale type.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between deep blacks and bright, saturated yellows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Large display text uses thick strokes and prominent rectangular serifs
Secondary text is a clean, medium-weight sans-serif
Primary text features a thin, high-contrast outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'j' and 'g' in secondary text have simplified descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, traditional slab serif and a modern, clean sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and flat terminals.
Provides the clean, neutral contrast for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an abstract texture of fire and embers with a heavy vertical motion blur filter applied, using a palette of deep black, burnt orange, and bright gold.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the primary text in a large slab-serif font with a thin gold outline and dark fill. Place secondary sans-serif text in white directly above it, aligned to the left edge of the primary text.

verificationChecks: Background must have vertical directional blur
Primary text must have a visible outline
Color palette must be restricted to fire-like tones

adjustableVariables: Ratio of gold to black in background
mustRedesign: Exact wording from the original image

mustAchieve: Dynamic sense of motion in background
avoid: Cool colors like blue or green

postGenerationChecks: Is the background blur strictly vertical?
Does the text have an outer glow for separation?
Are the colors saturated and warm?
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical motion blur background + Outlined slab-serif center text + Sans-serif subtitle.
